Name: Cinderleaf - Mod Manager
Author: 9meia9meia9meia
Description:
[size=5][b]Cinderleaf[/b][/size]

Cinderleaf is a portable Stardew Valley mod manager for Windows. It helps you see what is installed, bring in the archives you've downloaded, and review changes before they touch your Mods folder.

You can use it with just your main Mods folder. If you like trying updates separately, add a sandbox Mods folder too. The sandbox is optional, and it does [b]not[/b] separate your Stardew Valley saves.

[b]What you can do[/b]
[list]
[*]Scan installed mods, check for updates, and launch the game with or without SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Watch a downloads folder or add a mod archive yourself. Cinderleaf shows an install plan before writing files and archives replaced copies for recovery.[/*]
[*]Keep alternate mod profiles. The Default profile stays in step with your main library; custom profiles start empty.[/*]
[*]Compare your main and sandbox Mods folders. In 1.6.0, you can review a selected one-way sync in either direction before it runs.[/*]
[*]Find archived copies and check install recovery in History.[/*]
[/list]
[b]New in 1.6.0[/b]

Compare can now move selected mods between the main and sandbox setups after showing the direction, destination, replacements, and archive location. Related folders that belong to one mod move together. Install plans stop if files change after you review them, and History checks both the installed mod and its archived copy before offering automatic recovery. This release also brings a new app icon and another pass over the interface, update-source handling, SMAPI feedback, and English and Brazilian Portuguese text.

[b]Before you upgrade[/b]

Back up your Cinderleaf state and Mods folders. Version 1.6.0 can read older install history, but it writes a newer format that 1.5.0 cannot read. Once you've used 1.6.0, don't go back to 1.5.0 with the same state.

[b]Download and setup[/b]

Download the 1.6.0 Windows portable ZIP from the Files tab, extract the whole folder, and run [b]Cinderleaf.exe[/b]. It is not an installer, and you do not need Python. In Setup, point it at your game and Mods folders; add a sandbox only if you want one.

Cinderleaf does not download mods for you, and SMAPI is not bundled. Get mods from their original pages and install SMAPI separately if you use it. A Nexus API key is optional for normal local use, but Nexus-specific update checks need one.

This build is [b]unsigned[/b], so Windows may show a SmartScreen warning. The matching [b].sha256[/b] file on the [url=https://github.com/meiameiameia/Cinderleaf/releases/tag/v1.6.0]GitHub release[/url] lets you verify the ZIP before deciding whether to run it. You do not need to disable Windows security settings.

Windows is the supported 1.6.0 portable release. The experimental Linux build is still available under 1.5.0; there is no validated 1.6.0 Linux portable yet.

Guides: [url=https://github.com/meiameiameia/Cinderleaf/blob/v1.6.0/docs/USER_GUIDE.md]English[/url] · [url=https://github.com/meiameiameia/Cinderleaf/blob/v1.6.0/docs/i18n/pt-BR/USER_GUIDE.md]Português (Brasil)[/url]

Cinderleaf's own code uses the PolyForm Noncommercial license. The portable ZIP includes separate notices and license terms for bundled software such as Qt/PySide6; matching Qt/PySide6 source archives are attached to the GitHub release.

Found a problem? [url=https://github.com/meiameiameia/Cinderleaf/issues]Open a GitHub issue[/url]. Please remove personal paths, API keys, and private details from logs before posting them.
